name: Product Video Generator
author: Acacia Dynamic

sections.description:
The first tool on the market capable of automatically creating videos from a product sheet,
Product Video Generator highlights your products, makes them more attractive and keeps web users on your site for longer.
-> Boost your e-shop
-> Increase your conversion rate
-> Automatically broadcast your videos on YouTube
-> Use them on your social networks: Instagram, Facebook, Tik Tok, etc.

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses the following third-party service(s):

  1. Product Video Generator
    • Purpose: The creation of videos of your products is done on our servers.
    • Data shared: Product pictures, name, description, price, categories.
    • Privacy policy: https://ProductVideo.io/en/privacy-policy/

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and conditions of this third-party service.
sections.installation:
From Dashboard ( WordPress admin )

  • plugins -> Add New
  • search for ‘Product Video Generator’
  • click on Install Now and then Activate.

using FTP or similar

  • Unzip ‘Product Video Generator’ file and
  • Upload ‘Product Video Generator’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  • Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Which Product Video Generator package would you recommend to get me started?

It all depends on your business. If you have an e-commerce site with few references, you can choose the Silver package. This level allows you to create 30 videos per month, so you can showcase several products on your site.
The Gold package is more comprehensive, giving you access to more templates and allowing you to create up to 70 videos per month.
Of course, you can upgrade at any time.

How many Product Video Generator video templates can I use?

Whatever your package, you have access to all the video templates in the library. They are updated according to seasonality and renewed and added to regularly. As soon as your subscription is set up, you will have access to the entire template library.

Can I display a video created by Product Video Generator on a page of the site other than the product sheet?

You just need to take the Short Code for this video, available in the plugin’s video library, and place it somewhere in the FrontOffice (for example on the product category page or on your site’s home page).

If I stop using Product Video Generator, can I keep the videos?

If you stop subscribing to one of the Product Video Generator packages, the videos you have created, whether active or inactive, are automatically deleted and you no longer have the right to use them.
If you have taken out the Social Sharing option, you can continue to use your videos on your social networks and your YouTube channel.

I want to upgrade my subscription. Is this possible?

You can change your subscription at any time by going to my account/subscriptions.

Can I use Product Video Generator videos on my social networks such as Instagram, Facebook and Tiktok?

Yes, you can! You can upload your videos using the Social Sharing option , which allows you to share them on all your social networks and your YouTube channel.

What happens if I end my Product Video Generator subscription?

Your subscription will be definitively terminated on the end date and the videos created during your subscription will be automatically deleted from your e-commerce site.

I have several shops. Which Product Video Generator subscription is best for me?

Each Product Video Generator package subscription can be used on one e-commerce site. This means you can choose the package that’s best suited to each of your online shops and upgrade it specifically. You only pay according to the needs of the e-shop.
You can also opt for Product Video Generator Tailor-made for a fully customised package and features.

Why choose the Product Video Generator custom package?

If you have an e-commerce site with lots of references and you want to showcase your products and increase your sales, the custom level is for you!
With the custom level, you have unlimited access to all our video templates: change your templates according to the seasons, your events, your product categories…. You can also request the creation of unique, personalised video templates.
Product Video Generator also lets you manage an unlimited number of sites and videos.
A personal advisor is also at your service to answer any questions you may have.

I’d like a customised video visual. Is that possible?

Yes, we can. Our team is at your service to create a visual adapted to the graphic charter of your site or for a particular event. Contact us here for a quote.

What do I need on my site to use Product Video Generator?

The Product Video Generator plugin is available for PrestaShop and WordPress. If you want to use Product Video Generator, you only need to install the module in your back office.

How do I install the Product Video Generator module in PrestaShop or Woocommerce?

Product Video Generator is very easy to install, in the same way as other modules or extensions.
On Prestashop, from the Customise/Modules/Marketplace menu; on WordPress, from your WordPress Extensions menu.

How do I get my product page to automatically include Product Video Generator videos?

This is the default setting. Your video will automatically be added to the location usually reserved for photos of your products.

Where are my Product Video Generator videos stored?

Videos are stored on your server. As soon as a video is created, it is uploaded directly to your server by the Product Video Generator module.

How do I update the Product Video Generator module?

When an update is available, you will be notified by email. As with all the modules you install in your back office, you just need to click on ‘update’ to access the new version. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us .

Can the Acacia Dynamic team install Product Video Generator on my PrestaShop or WooCommerce site?

Yes, we can install Product Video Generator directly on your Prestashop site or your Woocommerce online shop. Our support team will be happy to answer any questions you may have and help you get to grips with the Product Video Generator module. The Installation – Commissioning option is designed for this purpose.

I’m having a problem with the Product Video Generator module. What should I do?

You can contact our team here so that they can examine your problem as soon as possible.
